name: Sudan
value: Famine risk spreads to South Darfur
summary: FEWS NET says Famine risk has spread to South Darfur and persists around Kadugli and Dilling; Kordofan fighting goes on
state: FEWS NET's September 2026 to January 2027 update says the risk of Famine has spread to Sharg Aj-Jabal in South Darfur, where acute malnutrition in two of four camps assessed exceeded the Famine threshold, and persists in parts of North Darfur and around Kadugli and Dilling in South Kordofan. Sudan Tribune reported around 11 Nov that the army captured Iyal Bakhit in West Kordofan and downed an RSF drone; the claims could not be independently verified. Famine risk spreading to new areas keeps the Alert.
for_you: Civilians in Darfur and Kordofan face drone strikes, displacement and hunger. FCDO advises against all travel to Sudan. Aid agencies and neighbouring states hosting refugees, notably Chad and South Sudan, are most exposed to further displacement.
rubric_hit: Famine spreading to new areas: FEWS NET extends risk of Famine to Sharg Aj-Jabal, South Darfur
